report.summary: Chunk 7 of embeddings.py: implements _ensure_index, _spec_from_row, _projection_count, _anchor_row, anchor_provenance, _record_identity_anchor. All methods are present and logic is complete.
risks: _ensure_index | medium | The function calls _spec_from_row and compares with spec; if _spec_from_row returns a different object due to missing fields, collision detection may fail. | Verify that _spec_from_row returns all fields from EmbeddingSpec.

_record_identity_anchor | low | The docstring claims 'costs no extra embedding call', but this is uncheckable as no embedding call is shown. | Confirm that the candidate projection is already stored and no embedding call is made.

anchor_provenance | low | Returns 'missing' if row is None, else str(row['provenance']). The docstring says returns 'missing', 'created' or 'adopted', but only 'missing' is guaranteed. | Check that provenance values in DB are exactly 'created' or 'adopted'.

handoff.purpose: Contains helper methods for embedding index management and identity anchor recording.

symbols.name: _ensure_index
symbols.note: Inserts index metadata into DB; verifies by reading back and comparing.

symbols.name: _spec_from_row
symbols.note: Static method; converts a sqlite3.Row to EmbeddingSpec.

symbols.name: _projection_count
symbols.note: Returns count of projections for a given index_id.

symbols.name: _anchor_row
symbols.note: Fetches the identity anchor row for an index, joining with event_projections.

symbols.name: anchor_provenance
symbols.note: Public method returning 'missing', 'created', or 'adopted' based on anchor row provenance.

symbols.name: _record_identity_anchor
symbols.note: Records an identity anchor using the first projection if none exists.

claims.why: The code only returns 'missing' or the provenance from the row; it does not enforce that provenance is 'created' or 'adopted'. The actual values depend on DB contents not shown.

claims.text: Re-using a real projection rather than a synthetic probe text means the anchor costs no extra embedding call at index-creation time and checks precisely the invariant that matters: *the vectors already in this index are still what this backend produces.*
claims.why: The chunk shows the method selects an existing projection and inserts an anchor; no embedding call is visible. The claim about 'vectors already in this index are still what this backend produces' cannot be verified as no check is performed in this chunk.

observations.what: _ensure_index inserts then reads back to verify; if insert fails silently, the read returns None and a RuntimeError is raised.
anchor_provenance returns the provenance as a string directly from the row; no validation that it is one of the expected values.
_record_identity_anchor checks for existing anchor and returns early; then selects the first projection ordered by created_at and projection_id.
